title: EcoRoute AI — Sustainability Intelligence Platform
description: A full-stack AI-powered sustainability platform that provides data-driven environmental insights, eco-route optimization, transparent reporting, and community collaboration for a greener future.
challenges: The most challenging part was building an AI reasoning engine that accurately analyzes environmental data and generates meaningful sustainability insights in real time. Integrating complex data visualizations (BarChart3, analytics dashboards) while maintaining smooth performance on all devices required careful optimization. Managing authentication with role-based access across a MERN stack and keeping the UI both informative and visually compelling added significant complexity.
improvements: Future plans include adding carbon footprint tracking with real-time IoT sensor integration, a personalized eco-score dashboard for individual users, AI-powered route suggestions that minimize carbon emissions, community leaderboards for sustainability goals, and a mobile app for on-the-go environmental monitoring.

title: EduPulse — Online Learning Platform
description: A feature-rich e-learning platform where instructors can create courses with videos and quizzes, and students can enroll, track progress, and earn certificates upon completion.
challenges: Handling video streaming efficiently while keeping costs low was a major challenge. Implementing quiz logic with randomized questions and preventing cheating through tab-switch detection required creative solutions. Building a responsive video player that works across all devices and integrating Stripe for payment processing were also significant hurdles.
improvements: Planning to add AI-powered course recommendations based on user interests and learning history, a live classroom feature with real-time Q&A, gamification elements like leaderboards and badges, and offline content download capability for mobile users.

title: ShopNest — E-Commerce Platform
description: A modern e-commerce web application with product browsing, cart management, secure checkout, and an admin dashboard for managing products, orders, and customer data.
challenges: Building a high-performance product filtering and search system that handles large datasets without performance degradation was challenging. Implementing a secure, multi-step checkout flow with cart persistence across sessions, and ensuring the admin dashboard remained performant with real-time order updates required careful architecture decisions.
improvements: Future improvements include adding a wishlist and product comparison feature, implementing advanced analytics dashboard for sellers, integrating multiple payment methods including mobile banking (bKash, Nagad), adding product review and rating system, and building a progressive web app (PWA) for offline browsing.
